scope: Conditional function and IntModule algebra for correction completeness: square/cube fixedness, equivariant image, rational two-torsion averaging, norm-half kernel membership, kernel transport, half-choice independence and Frobenius-fixed output. Both original gates8roots0trusted. No desired quotient beta or corrected evaluator assumed. Actual HLP norm-kernel identities, encoded fields/varieties/Frobenius, full fixed-kernel transport, Picard/program/descent remain explicit bridges; native PhaseA geometry is separate, complete chain/cost pending.
statement: theorem rational_correction_complete {A J : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule J] (sa : A → A) (sj : J → J) (phi : A → J) (norm : J → A) (sa_add : ∀ a b, sa (a+b)=sa a+sa b) (sa_linear : ∀ n : Int, ∀ a, sa (n • a)=n • sa a) (sa_zero : sa 0=0) (phi_add : ∀ a b, phi (a+b)=phi a+phi b) (phi_linear : ∀ n : Int, ∀ a, phi (n • a)=n • phi a) (phi_zero : phi 0=0) (equivariant : ∀ a, phi (sa a)=sj (phi a)) (cube_on_two : ∀ a, (2 : Int) • a=0 → sa (sa (sa a))=a) (kernel_description : ∀ d, norm d=0 → ∃ a, (2 : Int) • a=0 ∧ phi a=d) (delta : J) (in_kernel : norm delta=0) (square : sj (sj delta)=delta) : ∃ t, (2 : Int) • t=0 ∧ sa t=t ∧ phi t=delta
